A glossy white cube-shaped charger is held next to it. A price tag overlay appears in the corner. (3) The man returns to the frame, holding the charger closer to the camera to show its side profile. He rotates the object to display its smooth texture and rounded edges. The background shows a blurry plant and a picture frame. (4) An extreme close-up shows the charger's metal prongs. He points to the single port on the bottom of the device while making expressive facial movements and hand gestures.
